# The workspace is the confidentiality boundary, not the machine

> One runtime can host two workspaces and one workspace can span runtimes; treating them as a single axis is the most likely source of a leak.

Applies to `crates/bancada-core/**`, `crates/bancada-meta/**`.

<!-- archwarden:yours -->

## Context

_Everything between these two markers is yours. archwarden never rewrites it._

<!-- archwarden:end -->

## Considered and rejected

- **Runtime as the boundary, one VM per client** (nothing refuses it) — Breaks on the first local project and on the first runtime hosting two clients.
- **Per-project confidentiality settings** (nothing refuses it) — With twelve projects you configure on autopilot, and the default decides instead of you.

## What keeps it

Nothing can. The boundary is a property of configuration at runtime, not of the import graph. What a rule *can* keep is the crate that carries no content, which ADR-004 owns.
